title: selliguea cruciformis
intro: Selliguea cruciformis, commonly known as Polyscias cruciformis, is a plant species belonging to the family Araliaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Selliguea cruciformis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
